mainEntity.name: Does Crazy Bowls & Wraps have gluten-free options?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Several bowls are made without gluten-containing ingredients — the Stir Fry Bowl, Sweet & Sour Bowl, Thai Bowl, Poke Bowl, Fajita Bowl, Power Bowl, Mediterranean Bowl, Pesto Bowl, Jerk Bowl and High-Protein Bowl — along with our GF Quinoa Falafel and all four edamame starters. 8 of our 9 flavors (BBQ, Buffalo, Caesar, Jerk, Mediterranean, Pesto, Power and Thai) can also be ordered as a Lettuce Wrap instead of a tortilla; Teriyaki is the one exception, because its teriyaki sauce contains wheat even without the tortilla. Because we cook in a shared kitchen we can't guarantee any item is free from gluten cross-contact, so we don't label items certified gluten-free — if you have celiac disease, please talk to our staff before ordering.

mainEntity.name: Does Crazy Bowls & Wraps have a gluten-free tortilla or wrap?

acceptedAnswer.text: No — our Flour, Tomato and Whole Wheat tortillas all contain wheat, so there is no gluten-free tortilla. For a wrap without gluten-containing ingredients, order any flavor except Teriyaki as a Lettuce Wrap, which uses romaine leaves instead of a tortilla.

mainEntity.name: What dairy-free options does Crazy Bowls & Wraps have?

acceptedAnswer.text: Confirmed dairy-free bowls include the Stir Fry Bowl, Sweet & Sour Bowl, Teriyaki Bowl, Thai Bowl, High-Protein Bowl and Poke Bowl. All four edamame starters — Garlic Ginger, Salt & Lime, Spicy and Teriyaki — are dairy-free, as are the Carrots, Broccoli with Olive Oil & Herb and Mixed Veggies sides. Use the Dairy-Free filter in our Nutrition Calculator to check any specific item, and tell our staff if you have a dairy allergy.

mainEntity.name: Is there a vegan menu at Crazy Bowls & Wraps?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every bowl and wrap is built to order and comes with grilled chicken as the default protein, so our bowls are not vegan as listed — they become vegan when you swap the protein to Tofu or Plant Based Chicken. Items that are fully plant-based exactly as served: Garlic Ginger Edamame, Salt & Lime Edamame, Spicy Edamame, Carrots with Olive Oil & Herb, Broccoli with Olive Oil & Herb, Mixed Veggies and a Banana.

mainEntity.name: Can I make a Crazy Bowls & Wraps bowl vegan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Ask for Tofu or Plant Based Chicken instead of the default grilled chicken. The Stir Fry Bowl, Sweet & Sour Bowl, Teriyaki Bowl, Bean & Veggie Bowl and High-Protein Bowl contain no dairy, egg or honey in their other ingredients, so swapping the protein makes them fully plant-based. A few bowls can't be made vegan by a protein swap alone: the Fajita Bowl and Power Bowl include cheese, and the Thai Bowl's peanut sauce contains honey — ask us to leave those out.

mainEntity.name: What are the best high-protein, lower-calorie options at Crazy Bowls & Wraps — good for GLP-1 or weight-management diets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our High-Protein Bowl has 62g of protein at 380 calories, the highest protein-to-calorie ratio on the menu. Other protein-forward, portion-conscious picks under 650 calories include the Buffalo Bowl, Caesar Bowl, Poke Bowl and BBQ Bowl (all 33g+ protein), most of our Wraps, the Crispy Chicken Bites starter, and Garlic Ginger Edamame at 25g protein. These are macro-based picks, not medical advice — if you're managing your diet around a GLP-1 medication or another weight-management plan, check with your doctor or dietitian about what fits your needs.

mainEntity.name: Are the nutrition values in the Crazy Bowls & Wraps Nutrition Calculator accurate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Values come from our official nutrition analysis and are estimated on our standard serving portions, so expect about 10% variance depending on how an item is prepared that day. Every bowl and wrap is shown as served with brown rice and grilled chicken — changing the protein, base, sauce or tortilla changes the numbers. Allergen information reflects ingredients on file; because we prepare food in a shared kitchen we can't guarantee any item is completely free of a given allergen. Please tell our staff about any allergy before ordering.
